open_points.subject: backup snapshot during a concurrent committed change
open_points.text: Normative rule 1 says, “a change committed while the copy is made goes on and is not in this backup,” but required test 1 says a backup taken during a write restores “either before or after it.”
open_points.question: When the backup snapshot begins before a change commits and the change commits before the copy finishes, must the backup exclude the change, or may it contain either the before-state or after-state?
options: The backup must exclude the change because its snapshot began before the commit.
The backup may contain either the state before or the state after the change, as required test 1 permits.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the normative rule: exclude every change committed after the backup read transaction began.

witness.initial: The store contains revision 1 of a project and no backup run is active.
events: Registry starts a backup read transaction and records its snapshot instant.
The owner corrects the project; the correction transaction commits revision 2 while the backup copy is still being made.
The backup is kept and the owner later restores it after losing the live store.
outcomes: Under normative rule 1, the restored store contains project revision 1.
Under required test 1, an implementation may produce a valid backup restoring project revision 2.
witness.observer: The owner reading the restored project, and any consumer reading its revision and corrected values.
